description: This Java source file defines a JUnit 5 test class for testing the behavior of skipping repayments on the first day of the month in the Fineract system. It includes setup, teardown, and specific test methods that configure global settings, create clients, groups, loan products, apply for loans, and verify repayment schedules. The test focuses on validating the system's handling of repayment scheduling based on global configuration.
